about: SC-2 natural-language scanning corpus. A single item or a chain step expects ONE of: a spec in the Screener's own criteria language (criteria_text, plus optional sort; for a chain step, the WHOLE spec after the step), ask (a local clarifying question about one slot), planner (the existing model path), or refuse. Values follow SC-2 section 4; PROPOSED ones are agent-sc's proposals pending the owner. Validated by tests/test_uct_agent_scan_sc2_corpus.py; scored by agent-qa.
